stories.title: Woman, man injured in double shooting near New Orleans East, NOPD says
stories.summary: A man and woman were injured in a double shooting on the North I-10 Service Road in New Orleans East Sunday afternoon, police said.

stories.title: Pipe collapse extends water disruption in parts of Plaquemines Parish
stories.summary: A waterline break south of Daybrook Fisheries has disrupted service from Empire to Venice, leaving some Plaquemines Parish residents without water.

stories.title: 1 killed in single-vehicle crash in New Orleans East, NOPD says
stories.summary: A driver died after being ejected from a car in a single-vehicle crash near Michoud Boulevard and North Lemans Street in New Orleans East early Sunday, police said.

stories.title: Little Woods shooting sends 1 to hospital, police say
stories.summary: A man was taken to the hospital after a shooting in the Little Woods neighborhood of New Orleans early Sunday morning, police said.

stories.title: Historic low water levels causing saltwater intrusion in Plaquemines Parish
stories.summary: A water line broke in Empire on Saturday morning, causing low water pressure for residents from Empire to Venice.

stories.title: Suspect in crossbow killing admits to Mandeville trail murder, sheriff's office says
stories.summary: Jared Schurr, 36, was arrested in connection with the death of 24-year-old Lizeht Rodriguez.

stories.title: Silver Alert canceled for critically missing New Orleans woman with medical condition
stories.summary: Robin Gilliam, 66, has been located and is safe, according to state police.

stories.title: Unrestrained driver killed in crash near Bourg
stories.summary: The driver killed was identified as a 24-year-old man from Cut Off.

stories.title: What's next for New Orleans riverfront park? See initial plans for wharf makeover
stories.summary: Public comment on the future of the Esplanade Ave. Wharf is open until Dec. 1.

stories.title: Ticketmaster offers tips for night two of Usher, Chris Brown Superdome concert after outage disrupts opening night
stories.summary: Fans faced long lines outside the Caesars Superdome Friday night after a nationwide Ticketmaster outage caused delays.

stories.summary: "Would you risk your lives for 27 cents an hour?"
